title: Translate parse errors into a domain error
summary: Keep missing fields, malformed numbers and invalid ranges separate. Map a library error into an enum and propagate it without panicking.

errorEnum.clue: Keyword defining the three distinct ConfigError cases

resultType.clue: Return type carrying a valid u32 or one ConfigError

required.clue: Option method turning absence into the supplied Missing error

propagateMissing.clue: Operator returning early with a missing-input error

convert.clue: Result method transforming only the error payload

propagateInvalid.clue: Operator propagating the converted parse error

failure.clue: Result variant wrapping the explicit zero-value error

success.clue: Result variant wrapping the validated positive integer

equal.clue: Macro checking that zero is a domain error rather than a successful count
